text:
elaine: Quick sync — Nimbus marketplace launch 11/15. Can we run a partner SEV sim Tue 11/12 10:00am PT? Goal: validate shared channels, war-room flow, and cross-org pager handoff. Who from Nimbus + SI should be in the war room? :calendar:

samir: I can make 10am but have a 10:30 conflict; propose 10:00-10:45 for the sim, keep it tight. If needed we do a follow-up drill. :+1:

jordan: tagging @partners-rep-nimbus — can your oncall lead join? Also add the hardware SI (they're doing the on-prem infra) and marketplace ops folks. Names: Priya (Nimbus oncall), Marco (SI lead), Anya (marketplace PM).

partners-rep-nimbus: Priya will join. Marco can do 50% — he needs the breakout war-room link ahead of time.

lucy: I can shepherd the war room. Proposed quick checklist (will run live):
- create #partners-nimbus-test and #warroom-nimbus-sim
- invite Priya, Marco, Anya, elaine, samir, jordan, mike
- verify bot auto-join works for oncall (deploy-bot)
- exercise one SEV: partner posts incident -> oncall auto-notify -> open bridge if not acked in 10m

mike: For automation: deploy-bot can create the channels and post the bridge link. We need the routing rule so the bot knows which oncall rotation to ping. Sample mapping (put in ops config):
```
partners-nimbus: rotation=redwood-oncall-nimbus, auto_bridge=true, ack_timeout=600
```
deploy-bot: Scheduled: created sim channels: `#partners-nimbus-test`, `#warroom-nimbus-sim`. Bridge placeholder: https://zoom.example/warroom-sim-1768881234

elaine: Perfect — lucy + mike, can you own channel creation and invite list? samir, jordan — can you own escalation doc & routing rules? I'll loop Priya and Marco into the calendar invite. :rotating_light:

samir: Quick question on pager handoff: if partner escalates in #partners-nimbus-test, do we want an immediate oncall page or a wait-for-ack window? My recommendation: 5m partner -> escalate to oncall; 10m no ack -> open bridge and page eng-sev.

lucy: Agree with samir. Proposed path (short form):
1) partner reports in shared channel (#partners-nimbus-test) with severity tag `sev:1|sev:2`
2) deploy-bot watches messages for `sev:` tags — posts to #warroom-nimbus-sim and pings `rotation=redwood-oncall-nimbus`
3) if no ack in 5 minutes, bot opens bridge and pings eng-sev escalation list (eng-sev, infra-leads)
4) if issue affects marketplace listing (billing/availability), notify marketplace-ops pager and account lead

jordan: Adding one more — we should record the sim steps and time-to-ack in a short doc so we can point to regressions later. I'll create a Google doc and share before EOD.

partners-rep-nimbus: Confirmed: Priya will be oncall for the sim and Marco will attend for SI. We prefer the 10:00 start.

elaine: OK all — action items: lucy/mike create channels + bot config (owner), samir/jordan write escalation doc (owner), elaine send calendar + invite (owner), partners-rep-nimbus confirm attendee list (owner). We'll do the run, record, and iterate. React with :thumbsup: when you own your item.

mike: I added the bot config to staging and scheduled channel creation for Tue 09:50 PT. Will drop the bridge link in the channels automatically.

jordan: Doc link (draft): https://docs.internal/partners/nimbus-sev-sim — ping me if you need edit access.

elaine: Great — thanks everyone. See you Tue 10:00 PT. :thumbsup:
